record.context_brief: ED degree of secant rational normal curve
record.original_question: Compute EDdeg(σ_2(v_d(P^1))), i.e., the Euclidean distance degree of the secant variety of the rational normal curve in P^d.

evidence.quote: Problem 14. Determine EDdeg(σ2 (vd (P1 ))), the Euclidean distance degree for the secant variety of the rational normal curve in Pd .

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $d \geq 3$ be an integer and let $v_d \colon \mathbb{P}^1 \to \mathbb{P}^d$ denote the degree-$d$ Veronese embedding, whose image $C_d = v_d(\mathbb{P}^1) \subset \mathbb{P}^d$ is the rational normal curve of degree $d$. Define the second secant variety
$$\sigma_2(C_d) \;=\; \overline{\bigcup_{p,q \in C_d} \overline{pq}} \;\subset\; \mathbb{P}^d,$$
i.e., the Zariski closure of the union of all (projective) lines spanned by two points of $C_d$.

For an affine cone $X \subset \mathbb{C}^{d+1}$ over a projective variety in $\mathbb{P}^d$, and a generic point $u \in \mathbb{C}^{d+1}$, the Euclidean distance degree $\mathrm{EDdeg}(X)$ is the number of complex critical points of the squared-distance function $x \mapsto \sum_{i=0}^{d}(x_i - u_i)^2$ on the smooth locus of $X$.

Determine, as an explicit function of $d$, the Euclidean distance degree
$$\mathrm{EDdeg}\bigl(\sigma_2(v_d(\mathbb{P}^1))\bigr).$$
artifact.category_tag: Euclidean distance degree of secant varieties
artifact.status_search_result: No closed formula for $\mathrm{EDdeg}(\sigma_2(v_d(\mathbb{P}^1)))$ appears to have been published. A KU Leuven AI seminar by L. Kayser scheduled for January 2026 is titled "Euclidean distance degrees of secant varieties to the rational normal curve," indicating the problem is being actively studied. A December 2025 preprint proves an ED-degree formula for curves parametrized by rational functions and could in principle apply, but its abstract does not explicitly resolve this case. No definitive solution is verified.

status_evidence.title: Euclidean distance degrees of secant varieties to the rational normal curve — Leuven.AI
status_evidence.snippet: Upcoming seminar (Jan 27, 2026) by Leonie Kayser on this exact topic.
status_evidence.claim: Indicates the problem is an active topic of current research rather than a settled result.

status_evidence.title: The Euclidean distance degree of curves: from rational to line multiview varieties
status_evidence.snippet: Proves a formula for the ED degree of curves parameterized by rational functions; abstract does not explicitly state the secant rational normal curve case.
status_evidence.claim: Recent related work on ED degrees of rational curves but does not unambiguously close the problem.
